summary: Validate a 1080p HomeBrain tutorial master and create the standard 1024x600 30 fps derivative.
inputs: A 1920x1080, 30 fps H.264/AAC MP4 master supplied with --master.
outputs: A 1024x600, 30 fps H.264/AAC MP4 supplied with --output.
side_effects: Atomically replaces only the explicit --output path after successful verification.
